feeds.title: Chi@Glance Blog
feeds.description: I'm Tavi. I'm a diehard Chicagoan that is always representing my city to the fullest. Whether you're new to town or a fellow Chi-Town native, I hope to share with you the joys of finding your new favorite hangout spot, happy hour specials to help you save a few dollars, establishments to help you celebrate that special occasion or ways to stay healthy after eating that bread pudding you splurged on last night.

feeds.title: The Chicago Files
feeds.description: Cher is a Canadian expat living in Chicago and the blogger behind, 'The Chicago Files'. Writing is her passion, and her work takes her from writing blog posts to devising interesting travel articles, and along a path where she creates new ideas for children's books.

feeds.title: Red Soles and Red Wine » Travel
feeds.description: This is Jennifer's personal style, travel, beauty, and foodie blog that started off as a hobby and a way to meet people in Chicago.

feeds.title: Basically B » Travel
feeds.description: I'm Britt. BasicallyB is my own little corner of the internet to share my creative side and hopefully make your day a little brighter.

feeds.title: NW Illinois Travel Blog
feeds.description: Blackhawk Waterways Convention & Visitors Bureau (CVB) is a non-profit, official State of Illinois CVB, dedicated to promoting the Illinois counties of Carroll, Lee, Ogle, and Whiteside as a tourism destination, and dedicated to helping you plan your personal trip here, or coordinate a group trip or event.

feeds.title: Rockford Area CVB Blog
feeds.description: Read the Rockford Area CVB blog and find the latest events, news, exclusive deals, and travel tips to help plan your next visit to Rockford, IL. RACVB is a private, non-profit organization established in 1984 to promote and champion efforts to make the Rockford Region an overnight visitor destination.

feeds.title: Travels & Treasures
feeds.description: Travels and Treasures shares travel and food inspiration in Chicago and beyond! Subscribe today for travel guides, tips, intineraries, and deals. Find the best things to do, places to eat, and activities for your next vacation destination.
